bull.b: Pemvidutide is advancing across MASH, AUD, and ALD, with statistically significant AUD results and antifibrotic MASH activity. Progress across multiple liver indications could support a broader franchise, diversify clinical opportunities, and strengthen the product’s strategic value if later-stage trials confirm these findings.

A substantial cash position and management’s stated runway through the PERFORMA 52-week readout provide visibility for advancing the lead program without an immediate financing requirement. This supports continued clinical execution and gives Altimmune time to reach important value-defining data milestones.

The board refresh adds experience relevant to late-stage development, commercialization, corporate strategy, and transactions. Those capabilities are increasingly important as Altimmune moves beyond early clinical work, evaluates partnership or funding options, and prepares to manage a potentially broader liver-disease franchise.

bear.b: Altimmune remains dependent on clinical development rather than commercial product sales, while revenue is small and declining relative to its expense base. Persistent large losses mean operating earnings cannot currently fund the business, leaving performance highly dependent on successful development and continued capital access.

bear.t: Negative Cash Generation And Financing Dependence
bear.b: Ongoing negative operating and free cash flow requires Altimmune to consume its liquidity while funding expensive trials. Even with improved burn, continued development spending can create future financing needs, potentially limiting strategic flexibility and exposing shareholders to dilution or additional financing obligations.

Important parts of the AUD opportunity remain unresolved because regulators must still shape the Phase 3 design, timing, and funding approach. Tolerability and discontinuation questions could also affect adherence, trial outcomes, or commercial positioning, extending uncertainty before the program can generate meaningful returns.
